prompt: Listen and choose the best response.
promptZh: 請聽錄音，選出最適當的回應。
spokenPrompt: When does the shoe repair counter close today?
spokenPromptZh: 修鞋櫃檯今天幾點打烊？

options.text: At six, an hour earlier than usual.
options.whyZh: 明確給出今天的打烊時刻。

options.text: I paid when I dropped them off.
options.zh: 我送鞋來時就付過錢了。
options.whyZh: 付款時間不是櫃檯關門時間。

explanationZh: 明確給出今天的打烊時刻。

vocabulary.note: than usual 用於比較平常的做法或時間。

evidence: When does the shoe repair counter close today? / At six, an hour earlier than usual.
